description: Minimal valid MT202 with only mandatory fields. This represents a simple interbank transfer from Deutsche Bank (DE) to BNP Paribas (FR).
test_coverage: Basic block structure: Block 1 (sender), Block 2 (receiver), Block 4 (message content)
EUR currency with standard 2 decimal places
business_rules_expected_to_pass: Valid BIC format for beneficiary institution (58A)
notes: This is the simplest possible MT202. Field 21 references a hypothetical MT103 customer payment that this MT202 is covering. In real scenarios, field 21 would contain the actual field 20 value from the related MT103. The beneficiary institution (field 58A) is BNP Paribas France.
